confidence_notes: Coffee, beer, cocktail and meal anchors rest on a few aggregated Boston-area or national price sources of mixed quality, some undated; the 2026 coffee figures agree most closely. Wine is cross-checked against an older Boston comparison and a national guide and is less certain than beer or coffee. The meal anchors are bounded estimates from general knowledge plus the search results, not from a specific menu survey. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Boston market context; no live listings or booking pages were inspected and no accommodation searches were run. The FX observation (0.7088 on 2026-03-20) comes from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page and may not be the latest RBA observation for 2026-10-16; verify on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors are based on Boston-specific aggregated sources (cost-of-living sites, a Boston expat pub price index, and a national restaurant price guide). Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for Boston's high-cost urban hotel and hostel market.
